RE: Protest Letter Against Oncor & LCRA TSC Bell County East to Big Hill 765kV Transmission Project (Docket
59475)

Dear Chairman Gleeson and Commissioners,

Thank you for your service to our state and for your continued commitment to protecting Texas communities from irresponsible
infrastructure projects.

1 am writing today to express my protest against the Bell County East to Big Hill 765kV transmission project proposed by
Oncor and LCRA TSC.

As a resident of Burnet County, I can confirm that this project does not fit our community values. Burnet County has
intentionally pursued measured, deliberate growth, prioritizing rural character, land stewardship, and community over rapid or
infrastructure-driven expansion.

And while it brings no benefit to our area, it also poses serious risks, and I would like to highlight several specific concerns:

  •    Ruination of the scenic and historic Hill Country landscape, which is an irreplaceable part of our county's identity.
  •    Proximity to homes, raising safety, health, and quality-of-life concerns for families who have built their lives here.
  •    Destruction of historic ranches, archaeological sites, and valuable cultural resources that help define the legacy of our
region.
  •    Economic impacts, including decreased property values, reduced county tax revenue, and increased costs from road
degradation during construction.
  · Safety concerns, including increased wildfire risk and the loss o f safe airspace needed for EMS helicopter access during
emergencies.

Given the magnitude of these concerns, and the overwhelming lack of public support, l respectfully request that you denv any
CCN amendment applications for this project.

Thank you again for your time and dedication to our state. I appreciate your consideration on this urgent matter.


Sincerely,
